title: BAST/7/2022 of SATNAM SINGH Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
BAST No.7 of 2022
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Harshpal Sekhon, Advocate
for the applicant.
Mr. Pratiroop Pandey, A.G.A.
with Mr. Pramod Tiwari, Brief Holder
for the State.
In FIR No.334 of 2021, under
Sections 8/18/60 of the Narcotic
Drugs and Psychotropic Substances
Act, 1985, Police Station Kiccha,
District Udham Singh Nagar, the
applicant Satnam Singh has been
granted short term bail for a period of
three weeks. This order was passed on
11.02.2022. The short term bail was
granted on medical ground. Now, a
Time Extension Application (MCRC)
No.2 of 2022 has been filed.
Heard learned counsel for the
applicant and perused the record.
Learned counsel for the
applicant would submit that, in fact,
applicant's liver has immensely been
damaged, it is working 10 percent
only. The applicant is admitted in
Maharaja Agrasen Hospital,
Rudrapur, District Udham Singh
Nagar, therefore, the period of short
term bail may be extended. Annexure
No.2, the Time Extension Application
(MCRC) No.2 of 2022 has been referred
to.
It is also submitted that earlier
the applicant was admitted in Sir
Ganga Ram Hospital, New Delhi.

Having considered, this Court is
of the view that the short term bail
granted to the applicant may further
be extended for a period of four weeks.
The short term bail application of
the applicant is further extended for a
period of four weeks from its expiry.
The short term bail application is
allowed accordingly.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 07.03.2022
Sanjay
